package.name: xela_taxel_viz_core
package.description: Shared JS core (rosbridge client, 3D rendering, URDF/mesh renderer) for Xela taxel sidecar web apps. Static web resources only, no ROS nodes. Extracted from xela_taxel_sidecar_dg5f's web/taxel_sidecar/js/{core,render} and vendor/ as a dependency-free package so other sidecar apps (starting with xela_taxel_operator_dg5f) can reuse the same rendering pipeline without duplicating or depending on xela_taxel_sidecar_dg5f itself.
